subject: FintechX POC Observability Plan + Next Steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Alan Chen <alan.chen@fintechx.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Jul 2026 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: FintechX POC Observability Plan + Next Steps

Hi Alan / Sophia 

Thanks again for the demo and the productive discovery earlier today. Quick recap and a proposed observability-focused plan for the 2-week POC so we can measure success objectively. Please review and call out anything missing.

Summary of objectives (what we heard):
- Validate Latency & Cost under representative FintechX traffic patterns (customer-facing chat + background batch embedding jobs).
- Confirm model quality meets your acceptance thresholds on the provided prompt set.
- Verify integrations for tracing, logs, and export to your S3/Cloud Logging for audit/compliance.

Proposed POC success criteria (quantitative where possible):
- Latency: p95 <= 450ms for <1024 token requests and p50 <= 120ms for typical requests.
- Error rate: <0.5% 5xx or failed completions.
- Cost: token cost per 1K tokens within 15% of our estimate in the MAP.
- Observability: Real-time dashboards with per-route latency (p10/p50/p95), per-model token counts, token-cost estimates, error rates, KV cache hit rate, and request throughput.
- Traceability: Distributed traces that link application request id -> Redwood request id -> model call spans.

Evaluation & observability plan (what we'll deliver / instrument):
1) Dashboards (we will provide sample Grafana/Looker panels):
   - Per-route latency distribution (p10/p50/p95)
   - Token usage over time and estimated cost by route/model
   - Throughput (requests/sec) and concurrency
   - Error / retry counts and types
   - KV cache hit/miss rate and effect on avg latency
2) Tracing:
   - Support for propagating request_id and returning Redwood request_id in headers/payloads.
   - Spans for 'request_receive', 'model_dispatch', 'kernel_exec', 'response_send'.
3) Logs & exports:
   - Structured logs (JSON) with request_id, model_version, route, seq_len, token_count, status_code.
   - Export options: S3 (parquet/JSON) or Google Cloud Logging (if you prefer).
4) Metrics to monitor during POC:
   - Per-route: p50/p95 latency, token_count_per_request, success_rate, avg_batch_size
   - System: GPU utilization, cold_start_rate, queue_length, host_uptime
   - Cost: estimated_token_cost_per_route (hourly/daily)

Ownership & timeline (proposed):
- POC length: 2 weeks (kickoff Wed Aug 4 - review Wed Aug 18).
- Redwood owners: Marissa (PM / commercial), Marcus (SE / technical lead), Rachel (customer success).
- FintechX owners: Alan (engineering lead), Sophia (platform).

Immediate next steps (action items):
- Alan: Share representative traffic sample (request rates + example payloads) and the evaluation prompt set by Fri Jul 31.
- Marcus: Share sample dashboards and tracing schema by Thu Jul 30.
- Marissa: Send signed MAP and schedule kickoff (proposed Aug 4).
- Rachel: Provision a shared Slack channel and monitoring access.

Attachments: obs-plan-template.xlsx (POC checklist), mutual-action-plan.docx (commercial summary), sample-dashboards.pdf (example panels).

If this looks good I'll send a formal MAP and calendar invites for the kickoff and weekly check-ins.

Best,

Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0172

From: Alan Chen <alan.chen@fintechx.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Sophia Martinez <sophia@fintechx.com>
Date: Wed, 29 Jul 2026 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: FintechX POC Observability Plan + Next Steps

Marissa 

thanks for the detailed recap. A few clarifications from our side before we lock dates: 

1) Dashboards: can you share the raw panel configs (Grafana JSON) so our SREs can load them directly? Sample PDF is helpful but the JSON panels are ideal.
2) Tracing & IDs: we need the Redwood request id to be returned in both the response header and included in logs so our downstream systems can correlate. Is that supported out of the box?
3) Log export format: we prefer S3 in parquet with partitioning by date and route (S3 path: s3://fintechx-llm-logs/redwood/). Can Redwood push parquet or do we need to pull JSON and convert?
4) Timeline: Aug 4 kickoff is fine but can we extend the POC to 3 weeks (Aug 4 - Aug 25) if we need time to run more traffic? We also have a compliance checkpoint and need to confirm audit logs retention.

I'll send the traffic sample and prompt set by EOD Fri. Also looping Sophia for platform questions.











From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
To: Alan Chen <alan.chen@fintechx.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 29 Jul 2026 15:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: FintechX POC Observability Plan + Next Steps

Alan 

thanks for the questions, happy to clarify. Short answers and implementation notes below.

1) Grafana JSON: yes 
   we'll provide exportable JSON for all panels. I'll attach the dashboard JSON in the kickoff dropbox and share the Drive link before EOD Thu Jul 30.
2) Redwood request id: supported. We expose x-redwood-request-id in the HTTP response header and also include it as a field in structured logs. We'll also add it as a tag on traces so you can link spans to logs.
3) S3 exports / Parquet: Redwood can export structured logs as JSON to your S3 bucket. For parquet ingestion we can either:
   - Option A: push parquet (we have a transform pipeline we can enable for POCs), or
   - Option B: push JSON and we provide Glue/Athena examples to convert to parquet on your side.
   We recommend Option A for quicker analyst UX; Marcus can enable that during POC if we agree.
4) Tracing schema: we suggest the following minimal span attributes: request_id, redwood_request_id, route, model_version, batch_size, seq_len, status_code. We'll share the proto/schema.
5) Metric tags: include route, model_version, customer_env. For KV cache hit rate we emit a metric redwood.kv.cache.hit_ratio by route.

On timeline: 3 weeks is fine 

Proposed updated timeline: Kickoff Aug 4, Baseline & integration week (Aug 4 - Aug 11), Load & evaluation week (Aug 11 - Aug 18), Wrap & review (Aug 18 - Aug 25).

I'll take technical ownership for instrumentation and dashboard handoff. Rachel will coordinate access and operational check-ins.

Marcus Lin
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marcus@redwood.com
